# ── About ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

> Julian Johnson is the founder of Unified Solutions Inc. and a **Whole-Person Catalyst** — an ICF PCC (Professional Certified Coach) and ACTC (Advanced Certified Team Coach) with 1,200+ coaching hours and 222+ clients. He is faculty at ExecOnline and Emeritus, and has guided leaders through advanced leadership programs in partnership with top business schools including Berkeley Haas, Chicago Booth, Columbia, MIT Sloan, Stanford GSB, Wharton, and Yale SOM.

> His background spans U.S. Army tactical leadership (Kosovo, Iraq), Fortune 500 consulting (Optum, Wells Fargo, Securian Financial), and a coaching practice that refuses to split the executive from the whole person. He reads rooms fast, asks the question others avoid, and creates movement in stuck systems.

> **Positioning:** Whole-Person Catalyst. Not performance-only coaching. Not life-coaching that ignores the business. The whole human who showed up — then movement.

# ── Services ────────────────────────────────────────────────

## 1:1 Executive Coaching
For senior leaders navigating high-stakes decisions, transitions, and identity questions. Holistic in scope, laser-focused in method. ICF-credentialed. Assessment-informed. Direct engagements typically from $350–$400/hr; 3-month minimum.

## Group Coaching
Peer cohort programs proven at scale through ExecOnline and Emeritus partnerships with top business schools. 6–12 week structured cohorts.

## Peer Advisory Circles
ICF-credentialed facilitation for executive peer groups. Monthly or bi-weekly format. Grounded in COO Forum and UFacilitate peer circle methodology.

## Team Coaching
ICF ACTC-level team coaching. Addresses trust, accountability, and team dynamics at the level where they actually break down. 60–90 day engagements.

## Organizational Coaching
VP cohorts, leadership workshops, and coaching culture development.
